Two people have been arrested from Punjab’s Gurdaspur in connection with the November 3 railway track blast in Rajasthan’s Ramsinghpur. Police suspect links to a Pakistan-based handler who allegedly supplied explosives for the attack. Investigators said the accused had made earlier attempts in October before carrying out the blast on November 3. The Rajasthan ATS is examining suspected financial transactions, social media connections and the involvement of others in the alleged network.
